sloka: तयो रुधिरसिक्तानि संवृतानि शरैर्भृशम्।बभ्राजुः सर्वगात्राणि ज्वलन्त इव पावकाः ।। ६.८९.४० ।।
transliteration: tayo rudhirasiktāni saṁvṛtāni śarairbhṛśam।babhrājuḥ sarvagātrāṇi jvalanta iva pāvakāḥ ।। 6.89.40 ।।

translations.english: Great heroes, endowed with speed with a network of arrows pierced on the bodies shone like mountains overgrown with trees.
